summary: Milestone 2026.05.179 completed in 74 minutes across 10 substantive experiments (plus this retro). All synthesis and analysis tasks completed successfully. One compute-bound task (NLA Collision Audit) was correctly blocked by preconditions when gemma-4-31B-it-GGUF was found not cached — the pre-launch preconditions discipline worked as designed. Two other compute-bound tasks (SOTA GGUF Benchmark and NLA Self-Learning) produced synthetic/placeholder results with sub-second duration_s, flagged by adversarial verify and labeled not headline-eligible. One retry was consumed on exp1731 (max-turns on first Claude Code attempt). Key advances: CEM substrate prototype, LM-EBM bijection derivation, paper-v6 updated with Phase 4 findings, k=16 reweighting with 2.86% lift, and PWA/MILP formal verification formulation.

estimated_time_savings_rationale: 21 minutes consumed by exp1731 retry loop; 13 minutes of that recoverable by higher max_turns. An additional 5-8 minutes saved by not running synthetic-placeholder compute tasks that must be re-run anyway.
meta_reflection: This milestone demonstrates the preconditions discipline functioning correctly for one task (exp1726 emitted blocked_model_not_cached rather than fabricating) while two other compute-bound tasks fell through to synthetic placeholders without triggering blocked_ verdicts. The distinction: exp1726 had an explicit PRECONDITIONS block that checked for model existence; exp1728 and exp1731 did not enforce the check cleanly, so the agents completed with synthetic data rather than blocking. This confirms that precondition clauses must be mandatory and checked strictly — not merely present in the prompt — to prevent synthetic-placeholder drift. The k=16 reweighting (2.86% lift) and PWA/MILP formulation are genuine synthesis advances this milestone.
